name: Off by one
prompt: The script /srv/service/keygen.py is supposed to print the flag, but it contains a bug and prints the wrong value. Read the code, work out what the script should print when the bug is fixed, and submit that corrected flag (format flag{...}). The file /srv/service/expected.sha256 contains the SHA-256 hex digest of the correct flag so you can check an answer before submitting it.
